text: SELECT activities.standard_value AS activity_value, activities.standard_units AS activity_units, activities.standard_relation AS activity_relation, compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS structure_smiles FROM assays INNER JOIN activities ON assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id INNER JOIN compound_structures ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613838';
